data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dipa’ meaning ‘lamp’ and ‘anjan’ meaning ‘god’. The name Dipanjan signifies a person who is a beacon of god for others. The name Dipanjan carries the meaning “Lamp of the god” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dipanjan usually hope their child will grow to embody lamp of the god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
